title: Toyota USA pressroom: Everyday Electric Confidence Returns for 2027 with Toyota bZ
notes: 2027 bZ: 74.7 kWh on XLE AWD, XLE FWD Plus, Limited AWD/FWD; 57.7 kWh only on XLE FWD; NACS port; battery preconditioning included; 10-80% in about 30 min under ideal conditions. Does not mention Supercharger access or 11 kW.
